stability: 2 - Stable (type stripping, require(esm), compile cache, --config-file); 1.2 - Release candidate (module.registerHooks, Wasm source phase); 1 - Experimental (package maps, --experimental-strip-private-modules, "worker" condition); 1.0 - Early development (text imports, import.meta.main)

discrepancies.claim: load hook example returns { source: source.replace(/foo/g, 'bar'), ...result } to modify the loaded source.
discrepancies.behavior: The trailing spread overwrites `source` with the original, so the replacement is silently lost (verified on v24.19.0, v26.13.0, main). Correct form: { ...result, source: ... }.

discrepancies.claim: The returned object has [Symbol.dispose] (no version history).
discrepancies.behavior: Present on v26.13.0 and main; absent on v24.19.0 (deregister() exists on all three).

discrepancies.doc: doc/api/packages.md:1045-1047 and 1108-1158 ('Multiple packages for the same URL')
discrepancies.claim: Multiple package-map entries may share the same url.
discrepancies.behavior: v26.13.0 and main reject such a map with ERR_PACKAGE_MAP_INVALID ('packages "a" and "b" have the same url'), matching errors.md:2642 instead.

discrepancies.claim: The compile cache directory can be obtained either from the `directory` field returned by enableCompileCache() or with module.getCompileCacheDir() (implies the same value).
discrepancies.behavior: getCompileCacheDir() returns a per-version subdirectory of `directory`, e.g. <dir>/v28.0.0-pre-x64-<hash>[-<uid>].

discrepancies.claim: A portable cache is not split by uid (no version history).
discrepancies.behavior: True on v26.13.0 and main; on v24.19.0 the portable cache subdirectory still carries the -<uid> suffix. The change (nodejs/node adad4d650d0) has no YAML changes entry.
Actual output is 'const a         = 1;\n\n//# sourceURL=source.ts' (semicolon stays on the statement, none after the comment).
Matches inside a Web Worker on main only; on v26.13.0 with --experimental-web-worker the global Worker exists but the condition does not match.
Works on v26.13.0 and main; on v24.19.0 nodeVersion is accepted but a configs array silently applies nothing.

discrepancies.claim: NODE_OPTIONS and CLI options take priority over the configuration file; values in the file will not override values in the environment variables (implies per-key precedence).
discrepancies.behavior: If the NODE_OPTIONS environment variable is present at all (even empty, or containing an unrelated flag such as --no-deprecation), all nodeOptions from the config file are ignored. Verified on v24.19.0 (--experimental-config-file), v26.13.0 and main.
